name: thinloop
description: Simplify complex development with deep discovery, risk-adaptive Web experience and architecture design, reliable delivery, and concise experiential knowledge.

interface.shortDescription: Discovery, UIUX, architecture, delivery, and knowledge
interface.longDescription: Clarify consequential product decisions, design Web experiences and technical boundaries at the lightest useful fidelity, converge on shared machine-readable contracts, keep implementation scoped and evidence-backed, and preserve proven development experience without a fixed pipeline.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use SCD Discovery when product decisions are open, SCD UIUX when a Web experience needs design, SCD Architecture when domain, system, or shared interface boundaries need design, SCD Dev Loop for evidence-backed implementation, and SCD Knowledge only when I explicitly ask to capture or retrieve proven experience.
